claim: The completed provisional review is sufficient to freeze broad quality/noninferiority margins and a held-out sample size.
claim_type: Effect claim and measurement readiness for general, coding, fresh-session and EN/KO use.

claim_to_source_table.design: Frozen execution and exact identity/coverage verification
claim_to_source_table.directness: Direct for review completion; does not estimate product quality.

claim_to_source_table.design: One Astra/xhigh assessor configuration, fresh opaque contexts, fixed ordinal rubric
claim_to_source_table.basis: 60 selected pilot/diagnostic packets; 48 EN and 12 KO
claim_to_source_table.directness: Direct to retained artifacts; indirect to broad real-world quality.

claim_to_source_table.design: Static source/claim audit after ratings lock
claim_to_source_table.basis: All raw critical failures plus material disagreements and evidence-sufficiency inconsistencies
claim_to_source_table.directness: Supports bounded defects and identifies a reviewer error; no causal effect estimate.

quality_dimensions.design_rigor: Strong identity/freeze/attempt accounting; engineering pilot sampling only.
quality_dimensions.bias_risk: One assessor configuration, 50 self-declared limited-blinding packets, shared upstream artifacts; no independent human calibration.
quality_dimensions.measurement_validity: Ordinal anchors, verified checker gaps, one lifecycle interpretation error and inconsistent efficiency sufficiency.
quality_dimensions.completeness: All requested reviews completed; 40 raw packet statuses remain unassessable, seven review invocations lack usage, human/billing/backend echo remain missing.
quality_dimensions.applicability: Nine authored tasks with at most two repeated outcome cells per condition; separate diagnostics cannot define a broad task population.

quality_limits: The practical acceptable loss/tolerance is not supplied by the ordinal anchors.
Selected pilot tasks and repeated single-task outcomes do not provide representative paired quality variance.
Account-side isolation remains unproven for memory-effect comparisons.
Model scores are supplemental and cannot be converted into human scores.
hierarchy_position_and_limits: Frozen artifact/source evidence is strong for specific static defects; deterministic flags prove only the tests they encode. The model ratings are provisional artifact judgments, not independent population validation. All streams largely share the same synthetic corpus.
agreement_and_conflicts: Shipping counterexamples and public budget questions are supported by direct artifacts; the claimed retention false negative is contradicted by lifecycle=proposed and the accepted-only predicate. Raw ratings and historic flags remain unchanged.
missing_evidence: Defined target task population and claim-specific practical tolerance
Calibrated evidence/acceptance coverage and rater reliability
Adequate independent task-level variance for the intended paired design
Human review when available; otherwise an explicitly scoped and calibrated model-only claim
Account-side isolation for causal memory claims; billing for monetary claims
resulting_evidence_state: Held for broad quantitative quality/noninferiority claims; provisional for corpus descriptions; verified for completion of this AI-review lane.
calibrated_conclusion: No defensible numerical margin or held-out sample size is frozen from these ratings. No held-out call is run and no profile or release is promoted. Missing human review does not prevent this completed provisional lane.
flip_condition: A new prospective pilot defines task population, precise input domains and evidence coverage, calibrates the judge and measures independent task-level variation; a practical tolerance is justified for the intended claim. Then commit a new immutable held-out protocol before its first outcome call.
